baseline.note: Most moving and controlled; the January-first backstory and the pharmacist's quiet act land cleanly, if slightly familiar.

merged.note: Funny, lived-in workplace voice and a charming granddaughter reveal; diffuse middle and a slack ending.

writing-skill.note: Sincere NICU premise, well paced, but conventional and sentimental; the tidy reveal is predictable.

storyscope.note: Fresh, wry voice and a twist undercutting sentimentality; the survey reveal surprises, though the ending trails off.
